children: Ecuador’s annual inflation rate rose to 1.34% in September 2026, the first increase in three months, from 1.12% in August in the same year.
Food prices fell 0.12%, a much milder deflation than the 1.32% drop in August. Goods inflation accelerated to 1.06% from 0.74%, while services inflation edged up to 1.69% from 1.60%.
Fuel prices surged 18.95%, although the increase was slower than August’s 24.64%.
Compared to the previous month, the CPI went up 0.3%.

title: Ecuador Inflation Rate Rises in September
